about.heading: About Nvoy
paragraphs: Nvoy was founded by Ankita Mittal, a lifelong hotel enthusiast who has spent years studying what separates a good stay from a memorable one: the right room category, the right floor, the property worth the premium and the one that isn't. That curiosity became a profession, and Nvoy is the result.

Her mission is to open up the insider rates and privileges that were once reserved for a small circle of luxury advisors, and to pair them with candid advice on where those privileges are worth having and where they are not.
When she isn't researching hotels, she is usually staying in one. She travels to test what she recommends, and every shortlist she sends reflects that.

faq.q: How is Nvoy different from booking on Expedia or the hotel's website?
faq.a: Expedia and most websites don't have access to the exclusive luxury programmes (Marriott STARS and Luminous, Hyatt Privé, Accor Preferred and others). Booking through Nvoy gets you those perks: free nights, $100 credits, room upgrades, breakfast, at a rate that is often lower than theirs and never higher than the hotel's own.

faq.q: Do you add a fee or a markup?
faq.a: Not on hotel bookings. Hotels pay me a commission after your stay, so you're never charged for research, booking or arranging perks. You see the rate before you book; partner rates are often lower than the booking sites and never higher than the hotel's own. If one ever looks higher, tell me and I'll match or explain it before you commit.

faq.q: Which hotel chains do you work with?
faq.a: The world's leading chains: Marriott, Hyatt, IHG, Accor, Hilton, Anantara, Four Seasons, Rosewood, Mandarin Oriental, Belmond and many more, plus independents through Nvoy's partner network and Design Hotels. The programme tiles above list every partnership.

Breakfast and the hotel credit are confirmed at booking and written into your reservation. Room upgrades, early check-in and late check-out depend on what's free on the day, so they're 'when available'. I tell you which is which before you pay, and the hotel sees you as a preferred guest, which helps.

faq.q: Will I still earn my hotel loyalty points and elite nights?
faq.a: Yes. Bookings made through Nvoy count as direct with the hotels, so Bonvoy, World of Hyatt, IHG One Rewards, ALL and Hilton Honors points and elite nights still earn, and your status benefits still apply, on top of the partner perks.

faq.q: Can I use my points to book through you?
faq.a: No. Partner rates are paid rates, and points redemptions don't carry the perks. If a points stay is the better deal for you I'll say so, and you can book that directly with the hotel.

faq.q: I already know which hotel I want. Can you still help?
faq.a: Yes, and it's the quickest kind of booking. Send me the hotel and your dates and I'll check the partner rate and the exact perks for those nights, usually within a day. If the hotel isn't a partner, I'll tell you plainly and suggest whether booking direct makes more sense.

faq.q: Do you plan flights and full itineraries?
faq.a: Hotels are the focus for now, and hotel-only bookings carry no service fee. If you'd like a full itinerary (flights, transfers, experiences, a day-by-day plan), I can put one together for a planning fee that depends on the destination, trip length and how much is included. I'll quote it up front before any work starts.

faq.q: What if the hotel has no preferred programme?
faq.a: Many independents are still Nvoy partner hotels with their own perks, so I check first. If there's no programme at all, I'll compare the hotel's own rate with the alternatives and tell you honestly whether there's any advantage to booking through me.

Use the form below, or message me on WhatsApp or Instagram with your destination (and hotel, if you have one in mind), preferred dates, nightly budget and number of guests. I'll send a quote showing the exact perks available for those dates. Nothing is charged on this site; you pay the hotel directly.

testimonials.quote: Five nights at the Hyatt Centric Times Square with our two kids, and Ankita had it all lined up before we landed: an upgraded room, breakfast every morning, a $50 food and drink credit and early check-in because we were arriving at 2:30. Nothing extra on the bill, nothing extra for us to do.
testimonials.name: Ankur Mittal

testimonials.quote: We had an amazing stay at Sofitel Nusa Dua, my wife loved it too. They had the usual honeymoon preps done. The best thing was the plunge pool outside the room. Breakfast was top notch and the service was really good. Best add-on was the spa and food credit: we got a Balinese massage for both of us and it was very well done.
